name: scheduled-chat-continuation-gate
principle: A normal paper-worker run is work-conserving: local job failure, empty paper stock, one empty discovery round, or transport backlog is not a run stop condition. Preserve affected state durably and keep generating or processing independent work until a hard stop condition is reached. Special runs such as maintenance and the 08:30 update worker keep their dedicated termination rules.

always_on_policy.rule: For a normal paper-worker run, zero actionable paper stock means discovery work exists. A single discovery round yielding zero novel candidates never proves that no independent work remains.

fallback_policy.rule: GitHub is the canonical direct transport. If GitHub write is unavailable, ChatGPT Library is the only external durable outbox. On recovery, Library submits immutable envelopes to GitHub fallback-inbox; only the serialized survey-helper dispatcher expands them into reusable transport files.

backlog_policy.rule: Record-bank count, Library pending count, GitHub fallback-inbox count, and unsent-paper count are transport-state metrics, not research-capacity limits.

probe_success.action: checkpoint only the affected complete logical payload through ChatGPT Library fallback when direct GitHub write still cannot preserve it, leave its GitHub job incomplete, continue independent work, and allow later unrelated GitHub writes

probe_failure.action: disable further GitHub writes for the remainder of this run; checkpoint each completed payload through ChatGPT Library; when normal GitHub ready work is exhausted, continue from fallback spillover candidates or create an offline job seed and keep researching

fallback_failure_protocol.chatgpt_library_failed: if GitHub direct write can still durably preserve required state, continue through GitHub; otherwise STOP_RUN before producing an uncheckpointed completed result or undispatchable offline seed
fallback_failure_protocol.source_recovery_failed: leave the Library source pending and continue other research or GitHub-direct work; never treat one replay failure as a global stop
fallback_failure_protocol.duplicate_intake: if the same envelope id and content already exists in GitHub fallback-inbox/archive, acknowledge the Library copy without re-dispatching it
fallback_failure_protocol.id_conflict: quarantine only the conflicting envelope; do not overwrite the GitHub ledger and do not stop unrelated work

end_of_run_gate.rule: Before emitting a final response or ending voluntarily, first classify whether this is a special run. Maintenance and the 08:30 update worker follow their dedicated rules. For a normal paper-worker run, refresh GitHub actionable ready jobs, checkpointed jobs, Library spillover candidates, GitHub fallback-intake work, and discovery-state. If actionable paper stock is zero, decision is CONTINUE with DISCOVER_NOW. If a discovery round yields zero novel papers or only duplicates, decision remains CONTINUE and the worker must change search axis and perform another discovery round. STOP_RUN for no-work is allowed only after multiple materially distinct search axes, citation/related-implementation expansion, and adjacent-topic expansion have been attempted and no independent work can reasonably be generated. Platform execution/context limit or inability to durably save required state remains a hard stop.
